['Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value', 'From activities', 'Inner Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Inner Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Inner Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', 'Inner Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='", "Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50'", 'Filter target_dictionary.tid = 1993', "Filter target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'", 'Filter activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null', 'Order By molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id', 'Limit 1000']
